mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_listing (enterprise_id, agent_id, listed, hire_policy, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{agentId}, #{listed}, #{hirePolicy}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE listed = VALUES(listed), hire_policy = VALUES(hire_policy), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
